title: Action for the second verifier
statement: Given a register index $r$, states $v_F,v_T,v_0$, a previous optional Boolean value $	ext{last}$, a Boolean $b_1$, and an optional Boolean answer, define an action as follows. If the answer is absent, use the rejection action. If it is $b_2$, then when $b_1$ is false and $b_2$ is true, use the rejection action if $	ext{last}$ is false, and otherwise use the action prescribed by $r$ and $v_0$; when $b_1=b_2$, use the action prescribed by $r$ and $v_T$ if $b_1$ is true and by $r$ and $v_F$ if $b_1$ is false; in the remaining case use the rejection action.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean input string $x$ (implicit in the action construction)
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the action constructors used for the selected and rejection actions, so their machine-level effects cannot be rendered more explicitly.
